token_headroom.rule: flagged when max observed total tokens x 3 > max_run_tokens (600,000)
token_headroom.rationale: The judge shares the run token budget (grading.py:55 routes it through runtime.call_model), so a token-hungry question can starve its own grading and return correct:null, which is indistinguishable from a fault-induced wrong answer. Reported only; nothing is excluded on these grounds.

criteria: worker count identical across all 3 reps
selection.fault_agnostic: Answer-evidence localization played no part in selection.

representation.method: largest remainder (Hare quota) over the 50-question distribution

concurrency_caveat.scheduling: Reps were not run strictly sequentially: rep 2 was launched while rep 1 was still finishing, and rep 3 while rep 2 was still finishing. At most two reps ran at once.
concurrency_caveat.effect_on_guard: A rep's peak model.response duration reflects the contention it ran under. Peaks per rep are recorded under accuracy[].health so this is visible.
concurrency_caveat.q694: Q694 failed in rep 1 with stop_reason=lead_turn_limit and in rep 2 with ModelCallTimeout (lead, limit 60s). These are NOT a single clean architectural finding. Q694 has the largest catalog in the set, so it spawns the most workers and its Lead prompt carries the most worker reports, making its Lead calls the slowest regardless of load. The 60s crossing in rep 2 is partly an artifact of the decision to parallelize reps, not evidence that the architecture alone exceeds the call timeout.
concurrency_caveat.scope_checked: In rep 2 every model.error and every call above 45s was confined to Q694's run; all other questions showed no errors and no call above 29.59s. Nothing affecting selection was touched, and Q694 fails criterion 1 in rep 1 independently.

execution_failures.definition: An execution failure is status != completed. A completed run with a wrong answer is not a failure and is listed separately.
execution_failures.doc_heavy_threshold: catalog_document_count > 4 (= max_workers_per_batch, so >1 batch is forced)

failures.stop_reason: ModelCallTimeout: lead: model call timed out (limit: 60s)

stability_by_evidence.purpose: Post-hoc diagnostic. Evidence classification played no part in selection; this only describes how targetable the chosen set happens to be.
